summary: The lamp button only works sometimes because the sketch uses long delay() calls, making the program unresponsive for two seconds at a time.

causes.title: Blocking delay calls in loop()
causes.why: The runtime trace and code show that each pass of loop() takes 2.00 s because of delay(1000) calls: `delay(1000);`
causes.check: Try tapping the button precisely during the short window when delay() is not active, or hold it down until the loop restarts.
causes.fix: Replace delay() with millis()-based non-blocking timing so the button can be read continuously.

rule_findings.title: One pass of loop() took 2.00 s
rule_findings.evidence: Anything that must react quickly (buttons, sensors, motors) waits this long.
rule_findings.fix: Look for delay() or blocking calls in loop(); use millis() timing instead.
